messages.subject: accessing world map in ggmap
parts:
Hi there,
Iam trying to access world map via ggmap , I cant access it. can somebody tell what should i pass in the location in order to access the world map. 
Iam using the following query.
map<-get_map(location ="world",zoom = 4,maptype = "terrain",source = "google",color = "color")
plot( map)
Thanks
birender

messages.author: e5b24bf6388bb068
messages.subject: Re: accessing world map in ggmap
parts:
Hi Birender,

Here is what I did to get USA map:

install.packages("ggmap")
library(ggmap)

usa <- map_data("usa")


you can do this:
world <- map_data("world")

good luck
Ava
